definitions.explanation: A chronic metabolic disease characterized by high blood sugar levels due to problems with insulin production or function.

examples.english: My father was diagnosed with diabetes.

notes:
{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} refers to diabetes mellitus.

Types:
- 1⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (Type 1 diabetes)
- 2⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (Type 2 diabetes)
- ⟦{妊娠|にんしん}→妊娠：12227_ninshin⟧{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (gestational diabetes)

Related terms:
- ⟦{血糖値|けっとうち}→血糖値：19493_kettouchi⟧ (blood sugar level)
- ⟦インスリン→インスリン：24503_insurin⟧ (insulin)

- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (diabetes treatment)

Note:
Diabetes is a major health concern in Japan, with cases increasing due to changing dietary habits. The disease is called {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (literally "sugar-urine disease") because one historical symptom was sugar in the urine.
